requirements.title: Foundations page renders with live tokens
acceptance: Opening the site root shows the Procuresprint Design System page with the brand, the five-link design-system navigation and the core colour swatches
The live contrast check on the colour section computes ratios from the token values and shows pass or fail per pair
Every stylesheet (tokens, ps, docs) loads; no request for a stylesheet or script returns 404
requirements.source: README.md: 'index.html Foundations: principles, colour (live contrast check), status map, type, spacing, layout, icons, a11y'

requirements.title: Buyer shell renders from the page's body attributes
acceptance: A page with data-shell="buyer" shows the dark teal sidebar with the Procuresprint logo, the eight navigation groups and the signed-in user John Doe, Procurement Lead
The group and item matching data-module are marked current and the first two breadcrumbs come from the navigation, the rest from data-crumbs
The collapse control narrows the sidebar to 64 px, keeps icons reachable and remembers the choice on reload
requirements.source: assets/ps.js header comment and NAV; README 'A page joins the shell with <body data-shell=...>'

requirements.title: Top bar actions behave as the source defines
acceptance: Ask Me opens the assistant dialog on buyer pages and is removed from the top bar when the page already has its own Ask Me button
Notifications, My profile, Preferences, Delegations and Sign out show the toast 'Not wired up in this prototype.'
The user menu opens on click, closes on Escape and returns focus to its button
requirements.source: assets/ps.js data-todo and data-open handlers

requirements.title: Supplier shell renders for supplier pages
acceptance: A page with data-shell="supplier" shows the supplier rail colour, the user Arjun Mehta of Aster Components Ltd and the four destinations Home, Invitations (badge 3), Orders, Shipments
No buyer module appears in supplier navigation
The logo links to the supplier home
requirements.source: assets/ps.js NAV.supplier

requirements.title: Workbench tiles, views and search filter the table
acceptance: Clicking a tile with a match filters the table to matching rows and marks the tile pressed; clicking it again clears the filter
Choosing a view tab filters by its match and the row count in the table title updates
Typing in search narrows rows to those containing the text in the searched columns; clearing restores all rows
When nothing matches, the table body shows the empty state with a control that clears filters
requirements.source: assets/workbench.js render order: tiles, views, table; templates/workbench.html 'tiles filter the table, views, bulk bar, preview drawer'

requirements.title: Workbench table sorts, selects and offers bulk actions
acceptance: Clicking a sortable column header sorts ascending, again descending, with aria-sort reflecting the order
Selecting rows shows the bulk bar with the count and the page's bulk actions
The sticky first column stays visible when the table scrolls horizontally under 905 px
requirements.source: assets/workbench.js columns sort and sticky options

requirements.title: Preview drawer shows a record and its primary action
acceptance: Clicking a record id opens the drawer with the page's title, subtitle, alert, fields and timeline for that row
The drawer's primary action label comes from the row's status and leads to the record page or shows the page's toast
Escape closes the drawer and focus returns to the row link
requirements.source: assets/workbench.js preview config (title, sub, alert, fields, timeline, primary, primaryHref)

requirements.title: Forms validate on submit with an error summary
acceptance: Submitting Create Purchase Request, Respond to RFQ or Create shipment notice with required fields empty shows an error summary listing each problem as a link
Activating a link in the summary focuses the field; the field shows its own error text and aria-invalid
A complete form opens the confirmation dialog with the totals and, on confirm, shows the success toast
requirements.source: modules/supplier-rfq-response.html errs handling; modules/pr-create.html

requirements.title: Approval decisions need the declared inputs
acceptance: On Award decision, Approve award is refused until the no-conflict-of-interest declaration is checked, with the error 'Confirm the declaration to approve.'
Return and Reject are refused without a comment, with the error 'Tell the buyer what to change.'
A valid decision shows a toast naming the outcome
requirements.source: modules/award-decision.html comment and coi checks

requirements.title: Record pages offer the next step as one primary action
acceptance: Contract detail offers extend, source or expire as radio choices and the action button label follows the choice
Receive ASN records one line at a time with large targets and confirms the receipt
Purchase request detail shows header, lines, approvals timeline and the approver actions
requirements.source: modules/contract-detail.html rn choices; modules/grn-receive.html 'Dock use: tablet first'

requirements.title: Design-system documentation pages are navigable
acceptance: Components, Templates, Screens and Validation each render with the sticky documentation header and mark their own link current
The on-this-page table of contents scrolls to each section
Screens links to all 42 module pages and the six Home persona views; Templates links to the four archetype templates
requirements.source: screens.html, templates.html navigation and link inventory

requirements.title: Archetype templates render their signature interactions
acceptance: Workbench template: tiles filter, views, bulk bar and preview drawer work as in FR-05 to FR-07
Event console template: the clock strip counts and the ranking board shows bidders ordered by bid
Insight template: KPIs and SVG charts draw from the page data
requirements.source: README.md templates/ list; templates/event-console.html 'the clock strip and the ranking board'

requirements.title: Charts draw from page data
acceptance: Line, column and bid ladder charts render as SVG at pixel size with axes and labels
Chart colours come from the data-visualisation tokens and keep at least 3:1 on the surface
requirements.source: assets/ps-charts.js; tokens.css data visualisation block

requirements.title: Every internal link resolves
acceptance: Every href to a .html page in any page, in ps.js navigation and in workbench configs points to a file that exists in the project
Every stylesheet and script reference resolves in the dev server and in the production build
Links to theme/mui-theme.js open the file
requirements.source: Link inventory of the 51 mirrored pages

requirements.title: Unknown addresses show a not-found page
acceptance: An address that is not a page shows a page in the design system's typography and colour saying the page is not part of the design system
It offers one link back to the foundations page

requirements.title: Home shows the persona chosen by the view query
acceptance: Opening Home with view=cpo, cfo, approver, buyer, business or category shows that persona's layout and the persona switch marks it current
Without a view the default persona home renders
requirements.source: screens.html links modules/home.html?view=...

requirements.title: Fluid width at every size
acceptance: The shell and content fill 100% of the viewport from 320 to 2560 px with no horizontal page scroll
Under 905 px the sidebar becomes a drawer and tables scroll inside their own box with a sticky first column
Under 600 px form grids and page heads stack to one column
requirements.source: README.md 'Layout: 100% fluid width; breakpoints 600 / 905 / 1024 / 1240 / 1440; tested 320 to 2560 px'

requirements.title: Contrast as measured in the token file
acceptance: Ink on canvas 15.1:1, ink-2 7.0:1, ink-3 5.1:1, brand teal on white 11.1:1, status foreground on its background at least 5.6:1, input edges at least 3:1
Status chips always carry a text label, never colour alone
requirements.source: assets/tokens.css contrast comments

requirements.title: Motion respects the person's preference
acceptance: With prefers-reduced-motion the duration tokens are 0 ms and the sidebar collapse, drawer and toast appear without transition
Transitions otherwise are 120 to 280 ms
requirements.source: assets/tokens.css motion block

requirements.title: Keyboard operability
acceptance: A skip link is the first focusable element on every page and jumps to main
Dialogs, drawers and menus trap focus while open and close on Escape
Focus is visible with a 2 px ring in the focus colour
requirements.source: assets/ps.css .ps-skip and :focus-visible; assets/ps.js dialog handling

requirements.title: The source folder is never modified
acceptance: No file under .ai/knowledge is written by the build
The project's pages differ from the mirrored sources only in asset path rewrites
requirements.source: message: do not modify mirrored knowledge files or their sources

openQuestions.question: Should the preview self-host Plus Jakarta Sans and Material Symbols instead of loading them from Google Fonts?
openQuestions.blocks: nothing for the preview; matters offline
openQuestions.assumption: Keep Google Fonts as the source does until asked

openQuestions.question: Which enhancements come first: the open gaps in validation.html (PO and Invoice screens, Category Lead and CFO homes, Gilroy licence) or something else?
openQuestions.assumption: None built; the owner decides after the preview
